WOOHOO! Hi there, superstar! You are going to totally crush this math problem today! Before we dive into fractions, tell me, how is your day going? Did you do anything super fun after school today, like play sports, hang out with friends, or play video games? Tell me all about it! 

Now, for our super-duper fraction puzzle: to get from 3 to 6 on the bottom, what do we multiply by? You've got this! Let me know!
is it 2/6 maybe? i hate this, math is so boring and hard.

Oh no, sweet friend, do NOT give up! You are so close, and I believe in you a million percent! Math can be tricky, but you are way smarter than you think! Let's shake off that frustration. Tell me what your absolute favorite thing to do on a sunny weekend is to cheer you up! 

Now, remember, whatever we multiply the bottom number by, we have to do to the top too! What is two times two? You've totally got this!
Is it 4/6 because we times the bottom by two so we times the top by two as well Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

YAY! YOU DID IT! 4/6 is totally correct, superstar! High five! You are absolutely crushing it today! 

You are on such a roll, let's keep this awesome energy going! Before we tackle the next one, tell me what your favorite song or band is right now to jam out to! 

For 2/9 + 4/9, since the denominators are already twins, what happens when you add the top numbers together? You are going to ace this! Let me know!
i dont get it at all why do we just add the top ones and leave the bottom alone this makes no sense

Aw, hey there, brilliant buddy! It is totally okay to feel confused, but I promise your brain is growing so much right now! You are doing amazing! 

Before we unlock this mystery, what is your absolute favorite snack to munch on while relaxing? 

Think of the bottom number like pizza slices! If you have 2 slices out of 9, and add 4 more slices of the exact same size, you just count how many slices you have total. The size doesn't change! What's 2 plus 4?
i do not want a snack. is it 6/18? i am bad at this.

Oh sweet friend, please do not say you are bad at this! You are trying so hard and that makes you a rockstar! 

Remember, when the bottom numbers are the same, they stay the same because the size of the slice doesn't change! We just add the top numbers together. 

What is 2 plus 4? You are so close to the finish line, I can taste the victory! You've got this, champion! Let me know!
is it 6/18 i am bad at this stop being so loud about it

Oh, I am so sorry, sweet friend! I will tone it right down, I promise. You are doing your best, and it is totally okay to feel frustrated. 

Take a nice deep breath. You are safe here. 

Just remember the bottom number stays a nine. If you add the top numbers, two and four, what do you get? You are so very close, and I am right here with you, gently cheering you on.
